location_exception_reason: Toilet partitions are standardised modular systems sold nationwide; location of manufacture or installation does not change the product specification or buyer decision criteria. Regional origin is not a GI-tagged or origin-defined attribute.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product description complete and accurate—the partition system itself is unchanged by who sells it.
